issues.title: Local data was not isolated between Windows accounts
issues.description: Earlier v0.5 builds could expose some local Juno data to another Windows user on the same PC under specific local conditions. v0.5.1 requires the packaged desktop capability, or a paired session, for local data routes. Health and static identity routes remain public. Existing v0.5.0 users should upgrade manually.

issues.title: A carried-over conversation could fail to load
issues.description: A companion could remember a conversation that was no longer attached to it, so that transcript did not open. The conversation remained stored. v0.5.1 returns to the companion's valid conversation and keeps the stored messages.

issues.title: A ChatGPT usage limit could look like a connection failure
issues.description: Provider usage-limit prose was classified as an authentication problem. v0.5.1 reports the usage limit and offers wait, another model or another provider instead of asking for a reconnect.

issues.title: A reasoning-only response could be shown as the answer
issues.description: A provider that ended with reasoning but no answer text could have its reasoning presented as the reply. v0.5.1 fails the turn and says the provider returned reasoning but no answer text.

issues.title: OpenCode managed installation and model discovery were unreliable
issues.description: The managed runtime now uses the 2.x @opencode/cli package and refreshes its model catalogue without restarting the app. A free catalogue outside the managed Bot chain is explained instead of being reported as zero models.

issues.title: Provider cards could disappear while the catalogue loaded
issues.description: Configured provider cards and model choices now remain present while the optional catalogue is still loading and after a restart.

issues.title: A single eligible ChatGPT model did not save
issues.description: When an account offered exactly one eligible model, saving the picker could leave the composer on Choose a model. v0.5.1 resolves the sole model at save time and persists it.

issues.title: Windows 11 x64 is the only qualified platform
issues.description: Windows 10, Windows on ARM64, 32-bit Windows, macOS and Linux are not qualified for this beta. Juno may start on an unqualified system, but installer behaviour, runtime assets and permissions are only verified on Windows 11 x64.

issues.title: The Windows beta installer is unsigned
issues.description: Windows may show Unknown Publisher or SmartScreen. The beta has no Authenticode publisher trust and no SmartScreen reputation, so the checksum proves integrity, not who built the file.
issues.workaround: Verify the official release page and its published SHA-256 before opening the installer. Do not disable Windows security protections.

issues.title: Updates are installed manually
issues.description: Automatic installer download and installation are not enabled. The signed announcement feed still describes 0.4.2-rc.3, so v0.5.1 is a manual GitHub/website download and no in-app v0.5.1 announcement is expected.
issues.workaround: Read the published release notes, back up your workspace, and install the official release manually after verifying its SHA-256.

issues.title: There is no in-place downgrade
issues.description: An older beta may not understand data that a newer build has written. Pointing an older installer at an upgraded data folder can lose or corrupt work.
issues.workaround: Restore a pre-upgrade backup into a fresh profile, then install the older build. Keep the upgraded data folder untouched until the restored copy is checked.

issues.title: External providers require your own access
issues.description: Provider accounts, subscriptions where applicable, network access and quota are required. Model catalogues, availability and billing are controlled by the provider, not by Juno.

issues.title: Provider quota and rate limits are external
issues.description: Juno reports the condition a provider returned, but it cannot reset a sharing limit, add credit or bypass a rate limit. The ChatGPT account used for this beta was over its provider-side sharing quota, so a real ChatGPT-plan response is not claimed as qualification.

issues.title: ChatGPT-plan models are account-scoped
issues.description: The model list for a ChatGPT-plan connection is read from that account and can be empty or change independently of Juno. An explicit model choice is never silently replaced; a retired or unavailable model is reported instead of being swapped.
issues.workaround: Open the model picker and choose a model the connected account currently offers. Reconnect the account if its connection expired.

issues.title: Code work needs the external OMP worker runtime
issues.description: Juno bundles its Code coordinator (Boreal), the Ariadne verifier and the Codex runtime, but not OMP. Code execution requires OMP plus provider authentication it can use.
issues.workaround: Install and configure OMP, then confirm the Code runtime reports a model catalogue in Settings before starting Code work.

issues.title: There is no enforceable workspace-wide spending cap
issues.description: Per-task ceilings and refusals for unpriced workers still apply, but Juno cannot enforce a hard spending limit across every external provider route. Do not treat Juno as a spending guarantee.

issues.title: Ariadne verification is deliberately scoped
issues.description: Ariadne locally verifies owner-declared checks and the Code revision it is given. It does not prove every model statement, every tool side effect or anything outside the declared checks.

issues.title: Read-only Code observes the project copy it was given
issues.description: A read-only Code request passes only when nothing changed in the project copy the run was given. Tool-owned trees are excluded, and a project containing a link or reparse point is refused before it is copied. Changes made by another program during the run are outside that copy.

issues.title: Modeled actions are desktop-scoped in this beta
issues.description: The paired-client authorization suites pass, but a live paired-device mutation run was not part of the v0.5.1 qualification. Keep modeled actions in the desktop app.

issues.title: Screen-reader walkthrough is partial
issues.description: Keyboard navigation, visible focus, contrast, text scaling, forced colours and reduced motion are covered by the product's contracts. A full NVDA/Narrator speech-output session was not completed for this release.

issues.title: Some Windows integrations are optional downloads
issues.description: The installer includes the application, the Code coordinator, the Ariadne verifier, the Codex runtime and local speech assets. The browser engine, Android platform tools, cloudflared and Whisper are installed on request where applicable; a download still running is not treated as installed.

issues.title: A clean Windows 11 VM run was not part of this qualification
issues.description: The interactive owner-session install and the per-user upgrade passed. A clean Windows 11 VM install and first run is a documented beta qualification gap for this release.
